draft.hook_text: Your next chat has a face.

beats.line: Google just launched Gemini 3.8 Live with an animated persona.
The Live Avatar lip-syncs and shows facial expressions in real time.
It can transition between ninety-seven different emotional states smoothly.
Right now, this feature is restricted to Gemini Enterprise customers.

draft.script:
Google just launched Gemini 3.8 Live with an animated persona.
The Live Avatar lip-syncs and shows facial expressions in real time.
It can transition between ninety-seven different emotional states smoothly.
Right now, this feature is restricted to Gemini Enterprise customers.
